title: Agent JIT Compilation: evaluation tasks

field_definitions.id: Task identifier printed in the paper. REAL prefixes v1/ and v2/ identify benchmark versions.
field_definitions.implementation_id: Identifier in the saved experiment code; custom in this identifier does not imply a task was added by the authors.
field_definitions.task_details: Full task instruction from the experiment task definition.
field_definitions.paper_task_details: Description printed in the paper, which may abbreviate the full instruction.
field_definitions.is_added: True only for the 18 manually curated tasks added for this paper; false for the 19 selected benchmark tasks.
field_definitions.verifier: Evaluation type, entry point, configuration, and source paths.
field_definitions.baseline_steps: Task length under baseline Browser-Use, as reported in the paper.
field_definitions.oracle_schedule: Paper-reported latency-optimal schedule; null for WebArena, where scheduling was not evaluated.
field_definitions.definition_path: Task YAML file loaded by the runner.

usage_notes: Run tasks with agent-jit evaluate; see docs/TASKS.md for task selection and docs/LIVE_EVALUATION.md for evaluator settings.
REAL tasks use hosted application clones. WebArena tasks require the local environment described in docs/WEBARENA.md.
Paper descriptions and full task instructions are retained separately.
